claims.content: The player moves blocks on the board to solve the puzzle.
The game ends when the great square is moved at the bottom of the board.
All player statistics are frozen.
If the number of block movements of the current player is lower than the highest number of block movement recorded in the statistic file, the 'Finish Window with Statistics' is displayed.
Otherwise, the 'Simple finish Window' is displayed.

If the game is not saved, a dialog box is displayed that asks to the player if he wants to save the game. Two choices are possible: 'Yes' and 'No'. If 'Yes' is selected, the action 'Save' is processed and the main window disappeared. If 'No' is selected, the main window disappeared.
The user could erase all the statistics.
If the file was correctly updated, there is no output. If not, like wrong permissions or disk full, an error message is displayed.

If not (i.e., current player’s block movements are not lower than the highest recorded), the 'Simple finish Window' is displayed.
The 'finish' window is closed.
The statistic window is displayed.
The Player Statistics Window is composed of a listbox of 10 lines, each line containing the name of a player, the number of block movement, and the time used by the player to solve the headache.
The statistics are read from the statistic file of the game.
